author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
In this live stream excerpt, Adam Savage answers Tested member questions on tackling intimidating builds! First up: What should you do when you're "terrified" to paint a large miniature? Adam shares practical wisdom from his ILM days, from breaking models into subassemblies and sealing paint layers to his beloved DIY "blow dryer hot box" trick. Plus, Adam advises a maker on reversible, museum-quality mounting for vintage metal marquee letters, and explains why he loves when fans bring their own handmade projects to conventions. With thanks to philredbeard, JustinMatulonis and nahte1892 for their questions and support!

How do you overcome project paralysis when starting a huge project? Share your tips in the comments below!
